issuer: Tamaulipas's Secretaría de Finanzas (its tax offices)
note: Read 2026-10-30. The state's trámite catalogue (ficha 1207, Licencia de conducir, Secretaría de Finanzas / Oficina Fiscal, last updated 15 May 2026), its permanent link ?id=1207, whose content the page loads from muestrabusqueda.php, charges an automovilista licence $938.00 (8 UMAs) for two years or $1,642.00 (14 UMAs) permanent, and names the Ley de Hacienda para el Estado de Tamaulipas (arts. 73 and 74) as the fee's law; the two-year term and its fee are held, the permanent licence (which the page says isn't issued to foreigners, whose term follows their lawful stay) isn't. Pensioners and older adults pay half. The Ley de Tránsito (Periódico Oficial's copy, last reform POE No. 35 of 24 Mar 2026) asks the applicant to be eighteen or over (art. 19, I), lets a person over sixteen and under eighteen have a learner's licence (licencia de aprendiz) with the parents' written acceptance of liability, not held, and names automovilista among the licences the Secretaría de Finanzas issues (art. 19 Quater). The Ley de Hacienda itself wasn't read (the Congress's site sits behind a Cloudflare check and the Finanzas site behind a Radware one).
